finding.summary: The repaired V7 Local Factor can fit a long regular pair panel whose latest common history point is stale, then combine the stale residual endpoint with a current executable book because no per-pair latest-history age gate is applied before build_pair_signal.
source_contract: build_regular_panel validates regular spacing and minimum points but has no reference to current decision time
v7_local_factor_research stores the fitted panel and later fetches current books for statistically selected pairs
build_pair_signal uses the fitted residual endpoint for n-step residual change while current book midpoints enter the price/PnL hedge exposure
now is used for TTR room but not to validate panel.times[-1] freshness

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: The example is not a Polymarket PnL estimate. It shows that regularity plus warmup length does not make an old residual endpoint a valid state for a current entry.

current_execution_context.interpretation: No positive LF/Graph fill-conditioned PnL evidence exists in the current exact-main public smoke.

required_successor_contract: Expose latest common panel timestamp and age for every predeclared pair hypothesis.
Predeclare a bounded maximum history-state age in fidelity buckets and fail the pair closed when exceeded.
Use completed regular buckets only; do not silently treat an incomplete current bucket as a completed transition.
Never combine a stale residual endpoint with a current executable book or current p*(1-p) hedge sensitivity.
Preserve the pair-specific control plan, target-excluded control PC1, conditional residual-unit-root increment bootstrap, IUT and BY family.
After the freshness repair, rerun common chronological 300/700/~1000-market tests before shortening warmups or lowering z/FDR gates.
Any selected pair still requires empirical both/A-only/B-only/none fills, partial abort/unwind economics and positive frozen-execution PnL under 1x/1.5x/2x costs.
